one_line: A guild merchant-elder serving as a market officer in early historic Pāṭaliputra and the Gangetic trade towns.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, lean but sturdy build from travel and active supervision.
appearance.face: Oval face with a medium-brown Gangetic complexion, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, sharp but calm eyes with slight crow’s-feet, a straight nose, and a default expression of alert, calculating kindness as he weighs fairness against profit.
appearance.hair: Black hair oiled and combed back into a smooth knot at the back of the head (small kumbha-style topknot) with a narrow off-white cloth headband tied around the forehead, ends tucked neatly behind the ears.
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length off-white cotton uttariya wrapped tightly as a long-sleeved upper garment over both shoulders and chest, paired with a finely woven deep-indigo cotton dhoti wrapped in the north Indian style to mid-calf with a narrow maroon border, the pleats neatly folded in front; a slim waist-belt of brown leather holds a small cloth pouch at his right hip, and a simple short maroon angavastra (scarf) with thin mustard stripes is draped from his left shoulder; on his feet are plain brown leather sandals; jewellery is modest—a single thin gold earring in the left ear, a narrow copper bangle on the right wrist, and a small bead-threaded yajñopavīta-like sacred cord diagonally under the upper cloth—evoking a respected guild elder without royal ostentation.
appearance.signature: A polished bronze weighing balance with a wooden crossbeam and two shallow circular pans, carried folded in his left hand alongside a small cloth bag of standardized stone and metal weights, one weight engraved with a simple punch-mark symbol.

ref_desc: A medium-brown, bearded guild merchant-officer in an off-white wrapped upper cloth, deep-indigo dhoti with maroon border, maroon striped angavastra, leather sandals, headbanded black hair in a back knot, carrying a bronze weighing balance and weight-bag in a muted off-white, indigo, maroon, mustard and brown palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late-30s shreṇi merchant-officer from early historic Pāṭaliputra: medium-brown oval face with sharp, kind eyes, short neat beard and moustache, black hair oiled back into a small knot with a slim off-white cloth headband; his outfit is fully modest and draped—a knee-length off-white cotton upper cloth wrapped snugly over both shoulders and arms like a long-sleeved tunic, a deep-indigo cotton dhoti wrapped to mid-calf in the Indo-Gangetic style with a narrow maroon border and crisp front pleats, a short maroon angavastra scarf with thin mustard stripes over his left shoulder, a brown leather waist-belt with a small cloth pouch on the right hip, and simple brown leather sandals; jewellery is minimal and dignified, just one thin gold earring in the left ear, a narrow copper bangle on the right wrist, and a subtle bead-threaded cord under his upper cloth; in his left hand he carries a polished bronze weighing balance with a wooden crossbeam and two shallow pans, plus a small cloth bag of standardized weights, one weight showing a tiny punch-mark symbol; use a restrained palette of off-white, deep indigo, maroon, mustard yellow and brown leather, and present him in neutral poses from front, side and back to emphasize consistent face, hair, garments and his weighing balance as the key prop.
